messages:
olivia: Kickoff: need a compact copy bundle for tri-mode pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + 1-line social benchmark, webinar landing, and inbound routing rules. Goal: freeze copy by EOD Thu.
rahul: I'll sketch hero lines and three micro-CTAs per mode. Want to emphasize "predictable" for infra teams and "easy start" for product teams.
maria: Good. Also include two short proof bullets per page: one latency stat or SLA note, one cost/efficiency nugget. Keep tone practical, not hype-y.
scott: I'll own the benchmark blurb and the technical proof bullets. Recommend a tight social blurb: "95th-pct latency <120ms • up to 3x token savings in our tests"  engineering to sign off.
elaine: Security flag: Private page must mention KMS/HSM and on-prem installer options. Dedicated needs explicit "reserved GPU pools" and SLA phrasing. We'll keep HSM details in the product section, keep hero-level copy high-level.
nora: Routing plan: create distinct demo paths so leads auto-mux: /demo?mode=hosted, /demo?mode=dedicated, /demo?mode=private. Form fields: company size, primary use case, preferred deployment, expected monthly tokens, contact urgency. Sales wants a fast-trial queue (hosted) and an enterprise queue (dedicated+private).
copy-bot: CTA suggestion pack generated: Hosted ["Start hosted trial", "Try hosted API", "Launch a hosted trial"]; Dedicated ["Reserve dedicated capacity", "Book capacity demo", "Get SLA-backed throughput"]; Private ["Request private deployment", "Schedule an on-prem demo", "Talk to enterprise sales"].
olivia: Nice. We also need two headline variants per mode (6-10 words) and one short subhead (12-15 words) explaining the value.
rahul: Draft headlines: Hosted: 1) "Hosted API: Launch inference fast" 2) "Hosted inference that just works"; subhead: "Get a trial in minutes with predictable latency and usage-based billing."
rahul: Dedicated: 1) "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput" 2) "Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed performance"; subhead: "Commit to capacity, keep latency targets, scale reliably."
rahul: Private: 1) "Private deployments: VPC or on-prem" 2) "Bring inference behind your firewall"; subhead: "Customer-managed networking, KMS/HSM support, and deployable on-prem."
maria: Those read well. Scott: please pick a final benchmark blurb we can use in tweets and the hero proof strip. One-liner must be accurate and sign-off-able.
scott: Final social blurb candidates: A) "95th-pct latency <120ms • up to 3x token cost reduction vs baseline (internal tests)" B) "<120ms (95th) • 3x token savings in our benchmarks". Engineering, pls confirm which exact values are publishable.
elaine: Engineering will confirm numbers by Tue 17:00 PT. Security will review Private copy Wed 12:00 PT. If wording needs to be redacted we will move technical details to the product docs.
nora: On routing, we'll add utm_source and utm_campaign to all campaign links. Also will include a hidden field for 'mode' so CRM rules can auto-assign queues. I'll share the endpoint mapping sheet once provisioned.
olivia: Webinar: frame it as a practical workshop with short demos: "Production inference: choosing hosted, dedicated, or private". Proposed date: 2026-06-15 10:00 PT. Tom? (or whoever owns webinar)
scott: Webinar subject lines (A/B): A) "Cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" B) "How teams run predictable LLM inference in production". Landing hero: "Live workshop: production patterns for cost, latency, and reliability."
copy-bot: Short webinar CTA options: ["Register for the workshop", "Save my spot", "Join the live workshop"].
maria: Good. Also prepare the short social cadence: teaser (hosted), benchmark thread (dedicated), webinar invite (private), roundup + blog. Include unique UTM per post.
rahul: Note: on the Dedicated page we should add a small footnote: "SLA terms vary by contract; contact sales for details." For Private page, footnote: "KMS/HSM integrations depend on the deployment model."
elaine: Agree. Security prefers those footnotes vs heavy detail on the hero.
scott: I'll assemble the hero + bullets + benchmark blurb and share a single doc by Wed AM. If engineering signs off we can freeze Thu.
maria: Final: olivia/rahul finalize copy draft by Wed EOD; scott to provide benchmark line for signoff; nora to provision demo endpoints and routing rules; elaine to coordinate security review. Sync Thu 9:30am PT to lock schedule. Thanks everyone :rocket:
